name: MiniLinks v4 Notes Feature Multi-Worker Capability Routed DAG

target_application.name: MiniLinks
target_application.description: Lightweight SQLite-backed bookmark manager with optional notes and favorites

tasks.description: Update examples/minilinks/SPEC.md to thoroughly specify the optional bookmark notes feature. Document the 'notes' string attribute (stored as TEXT DEFAULT '' in SQLite, serialized in JSON payloads), update REST API contracts (POST /api/bookmarks accepts optional notes, PATCH /api/bookmarks/<id> accepts notes updates, GET /api/bookmarks returns notes for all items and supports ?q= search filtering against notes text), and specify the frontend UI bookmark card notes display and editing interface.

Implement and verify the optional bookmark notes feature in the MiniLinks backend. In examples/minilinks/app/database.py: ensure SQLite schema defines 'notes TEXT DEFAULT ''', implement automatic table migration if the notes column is absent, verify get_bookmarks supports q search across title, url, and notes, and ensure row_to_dict always returns a 'notes' string. In examples/minilinks/app/server.py: ensure POST /api/bookmarks accepts optional notes defaulting to empty string, ensure PATCH /api/bookmarks/<id> validates and updates notes, and ensure JSON responses return notes.

Implement and verify the bookmark notes UI in examples/minilinks/web/. In index.html: ensure the creation form has an input/textarea for notes (id='bookmark-notes'). In app.js: ensure bookmark cards render a formatted notes block when notes are present (class 'card-notes'), ensure the edit form populates and updates notes via PATCH /api/bookmarks/<id>, and ensure bookmark creation submits notes. In style.css: add styling for the card notes block.

Implement and verify comprehensive automated tests in examples/minilinks/tests/ for the bookmark notes feature. In test_api.py: test that newly created bookmarks accept notes, test default empty notes when omitted, test PATCH /api/bookmarks/<id> updating notes, test search filtering matching notes, and test validation on invalid notes. In test_persistence.py: test that notes persist accurately across SQLite database server restarts.

Harden integration between backend, frontend, and tests. Update examples/minilinks/scripts/smoke_test.py to verify notes creation, update, and search in the deterministic smoke test. Fix any defects across app, web, tests, or scripts so all unit tests and the smoke test pass with zero errors.

Perform an independent, rigorous final audit of the complete MiniLinks notes feature implementation across database schema, REST API contracts, static frontend UI, test suites, and smoke test against examples/minilinks/SPEC.md.
